Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.interact_async(engine, url, [{:click, %{selector: "\#open"}}, {:type_text, %{selector: "\#field", text: "test_data"}}, {:click, %{selector: "\#submit"}}])
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 0).action_index)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 0).action_type)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 0).success)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 1).action_index)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 1).action_type)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 1).success)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 2).action_index)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 2).action_type)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 2).success)
```
